Disappointment at Chili's
Jul 2022
I wasn't very keen on Chili's in Egypt when I lived there to be honest, but as I thought it might be different in Vietnam, I kept an open mind and order a different dish than in Cairo. I had cheese chili fries as a main course and as it arrived luke warm I asked for it to be reheated. When it was returned it did come back piping hot which was a definite plus. However, the chili con carne tasted just like canned chili from the olden days. I am not saying that they didn't use fresh meat and make it from scratch, only that it had the same taste as canned chili that a friend gave me in the past. So I found that a bit off putting. I am a bit wary of returning to try anything else from their menu but possibly will in the future. If I do, and it is a better culinary experience, then I I will review again with a higher rating. Finally, it must be said that this does not in anyway reflect on the staff in the D7 Chili's, who could not have been more attentive and welcoming.

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam66 contributions

Decidedly mediocre for the price. Did not feel like an authentic Chili's despite the branding.
Dec 2019
This was pretty disappointing to be honest. Pretty expensive and nothing like the real Chili's (felt like a poorly executed carbon copy).

1) Extremely limited beer range (only canned industrial beer available such as Tiger and Budweiser) no craft beers or any on-tap beers at all for that matter despite being advertised on the menu. 2) Mediocre food- the coleslaw was literally just (unevenly) chopped cabbage in big chunks and no mayo, no sauce at all, completely dry and unseasoned (and it's an item which must be ordered as a side). 3) The ribs were pricey and very small indeed- not value for money compared to other American style restaurants in HCMC. 4) The burger was decent but again, expensive for what it was 5) Service was friendly when it was there but it is definitely not American style service (no mid meal table check, no drinks check/refill, no suggestions given on menu and we counted 10 idle staff standing around in groups chatting instead of properly hosting tables). On two occasions we had to literally stand up and shout/wave to get anyone's attention. Not a good first impression. I might give it another go to see if things have improved down the line. What a shame! I was looking forward to getting a Chili's in District 7 but at the moment this is a pale shadow of the real thing.
